description: This file defines a JavaScript module for creating arc charts using D3.js, specifically within the 'd3.goteo' namespace. It includes a function 'arcChart' that generates customizable pie/donut charts with configurable radii, colors, and labels.

methods.name: arcChart
methods.description: Creates a configurable arc (pie/donut) chart generator function that can be applied to DOM elements to render charts based on provided data and settings.
